title: numbers STOP feeling real after this 🔢 | part 14
description: A billion seconds is thirty one years. Part 15 soon.
hook: Numbers stop feeling real after this.
facts: Every time you properly shuffle cards, that exact order has probably never existed before.
A million seconds is eleven days. A billion seconds is over thirty one years.
For centuries, Europe refused to treat zero as a real number.
Fold a paper forty two times, and in theory it would reach the Moon.
A flipped coin can actually land on its edge. About once in six thousand flips.
outro: Follow for part fifteen. Math will not apologize.
